data.name: Kori
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Kori was the goddess of the dawn, symbolizing the beginning of a new day. This name embodies the essence of renewal, hope, and the power of new beginnings. In Christian tradition, Kori is associated with the resurrection and the promise of eternal life.
